card.name: Units after statistics on change over time
card.fires_on: The unit or noun right after a number in a reported statistic, such as %, percent, -fold, pounds or cents. It is strongest when the figure describes a change or rate over a period of years.

modes.label: Percent after a number
modes.description: The % sign or word percent after a figure describing a rise, drop or rate.

modes.label: Other units after a number
modes.description: Words like -fold, pounds, cents or a squared unit that follow a quantity.

card.writes: It may prepare the model to continue with a time span or comparison, such as 'from', 'at' or 'year over year'.
card.plain: It fires on the unit that comes right after a number in a statistic, especially a percent change over time.
